event_request.info:
Welcome to another year of Drive Along, It is time to celebrate our 4th Year Anniversary and we welcome everyone to come join in with this Event. 

We will be starting in Italy in Bari and will be ending at Bologna, We will take you down some of the scenic back roads where you can get to enjoy the awesome views around it. 


Our fantastic Media Team will be here ready to take some awesome Photos of People's Trucks and we will also have some video coverage as well. :) 


* Start Date - Thursday 24th September
* Starting Location Bari (Slots)
* Ending Destination - Bologna (PP Chimica Italia)
* Meetup Time: 16:00 UTC
* Departure Time: 17:00 UTC
* Server - Drive Along 4th Year Anniversary

event_request.rules:
Rules for participants:
* The Event Staff are recognized as; “DA4YR | EF, DA4YR| ES, DA4YR | CC, DA4YR | Lead, DA4YR | Tail, DA4YR | GM" or similar.
* Free roaming is prohibited.
* Participants must haul a trailer.
* Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Participants should park at their designated slots. If you don't have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.
* Overtaking is prohibited.
* Cars are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.
* All other TruckersMP rules apply.
* Event Rules for Event Staff:

Rules for event staff:
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
* Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
* Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
* All other TruckersMP rules apply.

### Real Operations:
> Four (4) "Real Operations" scenarios have been approved by TruckersMP Event Management. This includes three (3) on a highway and one (1) on country roads. All operations have been reviewed and approved in line with our official rules. Any concerns regarding the actions or operations carried out by the Event Staff using the aforementioned tags should be directed to TruckersMP Event Management.
